title: below 120, o opens the panel and focuses it
spec: sidebar.md (thc screen on main) §3 (narrow: the drawer)
note: at 90–119 a panel opens over the view and takes the focus, so a script that types after o types into the panel

known.thc-screen/real: thc-screen: the first o at 100 columns opens the panel beside (the column) and keeps the focus in main: the host doesn't know the width until the sidebar's source has been read once (sidebar_beside true, $screen.width 100); headless gets it right
